Formula Objective, not the procedure: SSD = sum over regions A of sum over tracts i in A of |x_i - mean_A|^2, in standardized units unless standardize is false. A move of tract i from region A to adjacent region B gains g = (S_A - x_i)^2/(n_A - 1) + (S_B + x_i)^2/(n_B + 1) - S_A^2/n_A - S_B^2/n_B, summed over columns, where S is a region column sum and n its size. A move needs g above a small fraction of the four terms and must keep A connected.
